title: Repair apprenticeship chain
summary: Teaches repair skills without depending on one technician or unsafe improvisation.
content: Repair apprenticeship chain is a practical offline routine for skills transfer. List critical repair skills: water containers, bicycles, hand tools, clothing, shelter leaks, furniture, and safe electrical exclusion. Assign each skilled person two apprentices and one backup recorder. Break every repair into observe, assist, perform with supervision, teach back, and document. Do not teach dangerous tasks without proper tools, protective gear, and a stop rule. Sketch steps for offline manuals and rotate apprentices across families.
